hints.title: Balanced Shipment Condition
hints.text: A valid shipment must conclude with an element strictly smaller than its preceding maximum.

hints.title: Immediate Partitioning Strategy
hints.text: As soon as an incoming element satisfies the termination condition, complete the segment.

hints.title: Shipment Reset
hints.text: Reset the running maximum tracker immediately after committing a valid shipment partition.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Greedily seals shipments upon reaching the first valid drop.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Branching recursively on partition cut points yields exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses a single integer variable to maintain current block state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Show that committing valid shipments at the earliest opportunity is globally optimal.
